plateMenu.selectAllTip: Choose every object on this plate (Ctrl+A)
plateMenu.arrangeTip: Lay out the objects on this plate
plateMenu.autoOrientTip: Turn every object on this plate to print with the least overhang
plateMenu.deleteAllTip: Delete every object on this plate
plateMenu.deletePlateTip: Delete this plate and what is on it
plateMenu.plateSettingsTip: Settings this plate uses instead of the project's: plate type, print sequence, spiral vase, filament order
plateMenu.renamePlateTip: Shown on the plate tabs and saved in the project
plateMenu.unlockTip: Let Arrange and Auto orient change this plate again
plateMenu.lockTip: Keep this plate as it is: Arrange and Auto orient leave it alone
plateMenu.markNotPrintedTip: This plate still has to be printed
plateMenu.markPrintedTip: Printed another way, like from an SD card
plateMenu.printHistoryTip: When this plate was sent and printed
plateMenu.textTip: Letters in a font, edited in the Text shape tool
plateMenu.svgTip: The paths of an .svg file, like a logo
plateMenu.addModelsTip: STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP or SVG files from this device
plateMenu.pasteTip: What you copied or cut, as a new object (Ctrl+V)
plateMenu.copyFirst: Copy or cut an object first (its menu, or Ctrl+C)
